title: Add exact P104 ADD-coefficient fault localization (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Add an exact diagnostic for PR5568's open question about identifying the event behind a wrong ADD value. Given a P104 scalar endpoint discrepancy, it returns every single ADD coefficient replacement that repairs the complete map. Ambiguous repairs remain explicit. A zero residual does not certify absence of invisible faults.

```text
complete endpoint discrepancy
  -> exact rank-one residual test
  -> prefix/suffix proportionality
  -> every compatible event and replacement
```

Claim type: **scoped diagnostic correctness proof with finite evidence**. No new kappa, supplier, predecessor audit or selected-frontier change. The source-bound example changes event 0 of PR5561's word from -2 to -1. The new diagnostic returns exactly event 0 with replacement -2, restoring all 743 scalar outputs on all 735 independent public inputs. The new application and code are produced by Nick Petalas.

Package: `research/p104-add-fault-localization/`. Base: canonical main `3f0152a32eeebac0df11946dbd50cabe5a7f7839`, priority revision 8, refreshed before publication. The replay-runtime card is explicitly changed from speed to diagnostic capability. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19267658).

## Evidence

- Before: PR5568's scalar oracle identifies damaged endpoint rows; its README explicitly leaves ADD-event localization open. After: the standalone CLI returns the unique exact event and coefficient for the guarded P104 fault.
- Complete repair sets agree with an independently written whole-program scalar-basis oracle for all 3,756 injected faults over 340 small words. Every returned repair is applied and replayed; 7,740 compatible repairs occur across those cases.
- Singular-operation fixtures add 21 faults, including 12 invisible cases. Controls cover ambiguous events, rank-two and unrepairable rank-one residuals, nondyadic repairs, explicit target zeros, malformed programs and resource limits.
- Registered normal and optimized warning-strict checks pass. Timed direct runs took 1.42 s and 1.39 s locally, well below their 120 s limits. These are check durations, not a speedup claim. The actual diagnostic CLI passed separately.
- Committed bytes, executable modes and declared source-history ancestry pass at `045350fba7915f964248ca95f996eff3acc08239`, covering nine package/input files. The official export and declared-input integrity check pass. Optimized replay passes with Git absent and exported files read-only; all ten exported files, including the export manifest, retain their bytes and executable bits. Altered receipt and source bytes are rejected under optimization.

Exact reproduction from the repository root, CPython 3.12.15 and standard library only:

```sh
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/p104-add-fault-localization/verify.py
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/p104-add-fault-localization/verify.py
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-add-fault-localization
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-add-fault-localization --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Expected markers: `PASS_P104_ADD_FAULT_LOCALIZATION`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. `RESULT.json` is generated and bound to package/input hashes. Ordinary verification writes no files.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

Completeness concerns one changed ADD coefficient in the declared rational scalar program. Wrong operands, several faults, chronology changes and native/frame faults are excluded. COPY/INIT/CLEAR have their stated scalar semantics; their physical legality is not certified. The coefficient-rule flag checks only nonzero dyadic size admissibility. Native phases, owning legality, precision, tape, caller, compiler, BIT and outer suites were not run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No runtime gain is claimed.

Credit DreamingOfClouds / PR5568 for the question and tooling; Ali Romman / PR5544/5545 and PR5392, thu-nmrc / PR5551, PR5553/5561 and GamingPuzzled / PR5472 for the retained word lineage. Credit woklerx / PR1017 and Sagar Thakrar / PR762 for prior fault-testing and prefix/suffix sensitivity. The standard rank-one identity is not claimed as new. No predecessor implementation is copied or changed.

## Open next questions

- Classify indistinguishable and zero coefficient-fault signatures in one frozen P104 word. First group normalized exact signatures. No complete P104 fault census is claimed here.
- Join the suggestions to an owning legality checker while retaining frame, ownership and native obligations. First check one reported candidate through that verifier. The diagnostic never edits a word or admits a supplier.

## Related open work

- #6170 packages the P104 designer toolkit; this adds exact single-coefficient localization beside its endpoint-only oracle, without changing that toolkit.
- #6169 applies multi-gate coefficient resynthesis on PR6144. This diagnostic solves a single-coefficient repair question; it supplies no simultaneous-edit or feedback optimization.
- #6167 changes retained-operand chronology; its word and kappa are not replayed or compared here.
- #6144 changes owned-register descents; this diagnostic uses the older PR5561 scalar fixture and makes no invoice comparison.
- #5606 proposes a prepared P104 helper split; no split, target credit or supplier claim is checked here.
- #5553 supplies a P104 handoff predecessor retained by the toolkit; this adds a diagnostic on the later pinned PR5561 fixture and does not recertify its construction.

- #6173 computes two-channel support in a fixed P104 root code; it supplies no ADD-coefficient localization or competing repair count.
- #6181 proves a joint-bank P104 spectral obstruction; this diagnostic computes no spectral correction rank.
- #6172 optimizes an abstract variable-target tensor invoice; this diagnostic keeps the scalar word and desired endpoint fixed and computes no tensor optimum.
- #6180 certifies typed rectangular dirty circuits with independent operators; this diagnostic instead returns coefficient repairs for a fixed rational scalar endpoint.

The completion refresh read this account's open PRs created since the advance CLAIM. No other submission in that list computes the P104 coefficient repair reported here, and no numerical disagreement was found. No extra computations were run to check other contributions.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks passed at exact head `045350fba7915f964248ca95f996eff3acc08239` in [run 40880471561](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40880471561): [plan](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40880471561/job/123470308452) in 3m42s and [replay (research/p104-add-fault-localization)](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40880471561/job/123472283481) in 1m26s. The completed check list was read once and both entries report pass.

Hosted replay certifies the registered normal and optimized package checks at this head. All recorded local checks, committed-byte/mode/source-history checks, export integrity and read-only Git-free replay also pass. The scalar fault model, physical-legality limitations and unrun complete-supplier obligations retain their stated scope. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review remain unclaimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. **Blast Radius:** scoped. Eight new files in one research package; one unchanged declared input. No shared checker, selected certificate or frozen predecessor changes.
